fields.acceptance: A testscript in a repo whose rhiza-written docs/reference is stale and whose docs name a command the registry lacks sees rhiza check fail on both, and rhiza run code-check on a run there pass with neither among its causes; a test of the check op shows the option off keeps both rules (go test ./internal/api/... and the touched testscripts; describe-golden regenerated)
fields.statement: rhiza run code-check runs rhiza check with the generated-reference comparison (docs/reference against rhiza docs) and the docs-command rule turned off, through an explicit CheckRequest option, so a run whose change edits CLI help, settings or the workflow format, or adds a documented command, is not failed by the installed binary's reference; plain rhiza check and make self-check keep both rules
